caption: The drawing features a symmetrical floral motif painted in red, blue, yellow, and green on a beige background. At the center top, there is a large, stylized flower with pointed petals; the two main outer petals are blue with dotted red outlines, while the inner petals are red and yellow. Below this large flower, two yellow leaves with red outlines extend outward. There is a single red stem that branches out into symmetrical sections. Each side of the stem has two red, jagged-edged leaves, two small blue flowers with pointed petals and yellow-green leaves, and smaller yellow-green leaves scattered along the branches. At the base, the root structure of the flower is rendered with a geometric red outline, forming a looped shape. The entire design is centered vertically and horizontally on the page, and a small label at the bottom reads: "Drawn from a Sgraffitte Plate 1810."
title: Drawing for Plate 2: From Portfolio "Folk Art of Rural Pennsylvania"
